backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Nature Glow e-commerce backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for products, orders, user profiles, and site settings, with admin access control, Razorpay/Stripe integration, and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (FloatingWhatsApp button, hover animations, entrance animation, CustomerLayout mounting, etc.) to their source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key functionality of each component, page, hook, and style file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Nature Glow app, loading Cormorant Garamond and Inter fonts from Google Fonts, the Razorpay checkout script, and the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with customer and protected admin route trees, wraps customer pages in a CustomerLayout that includes Navbar, Footer, CartDrawer, and FloatingWhatsApp, and configures React Query and theming providers.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: A route guard component that redirects unauthenticated or non-admin users to the admin login page, showing a loading spinner while authentication and admin status are being verified.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar (desktop and mobile) containing navigation links and a sign-out button that clears identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: An admin UI component that simulates AI image generation by selecting a curated Unsplash botanical image based on a text prompt, with a preview and 'Use Image' action.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: A modal dialog that displays full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and allows admins to update the fulfillment status via a dropdown select.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: A modal form for creating or editing a product, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, image upload, AI image generation, and key-value specifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: A read-only modal that displays a user's profile details including name, email, principal ID, registration date, and total order count.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-out cart drawer component using a Sheet UI element, displaying cart items with quantity controls and remove buttons, a total amount summary, and a checkout navigation button.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A floating WhatsApp button component that appears in the bottom-right corner with a tooltip, pulse animation, and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat using a configurable or fallback phone number.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying brand info, quick navigation links, contact details, copyright year, and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer with links to Home and Shop, plus an auth button for admin login/logout, rendered as an overlay on small screens.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links, a cart icon with item count badge, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: A product card component displaying image, category, name, description, price, and status badges, with Add to Cart and Buy Now actions using Razorpay checkout.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: A headless component that seeds the database with sample products when the product list is empty on initial load.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: An in-memory React context providing cart state (items, open/close) and operations (add, remove, update quantity, clear) using Product objects with bigint IDs.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: A sessionStorage-backed React context for cart state using string-based product IDs, providing add, remove, update, and clear operations along with cart open/close state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing login/logout state via DFINITY's AuthClient and exposing identity, login status, and helper booleans to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the app, covering admin checks, products, orders, site settings, user profiles, shopping lists, and payment configuration via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom hook that loads the Razorpay checkout SDK, opens a payment modal with the configured key and order details, and navigates to success or failure routes based on payment outcome.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for both the customer storefront (Ayurvedic palette) and admin panel themes, including light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers wrapping the root App component.
Admin dashboard displaying key metrics (revenue, orders, products, users) alongside bar and pie charts for revenue trends and order fulfillment status, plus a recent orders table.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that orchestrates Internet Identity authentication, attempts to claim/verify admin status via the backend actor, and redirects to the dashboard on success or shows an access-denied error.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin orders management page that fetches all orders, displays summary stats, and provides search/filter/sort controls plus a detail modal for individual orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin products page that lists the product catalog with stats, supports search, and allows adding, editing, and deleting products via a form modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store name, contact email, announcement banner, Razorpay key, and WhatsApp number, with live validation and save actions backed by query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin users page that fetches and displays all registered users in a searchable table, with a detail modal for viewing individual user information.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal, shows an empty-state view, and triggers Razorpay checkout for the total order amount.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details via a form and initiates a Stripe payment session, redirecting the user to the Stripe-hosted checkout URL on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page displaying a hero banner, feature highlights, and featured/all product sections using data fetched via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static payment failure page shown after an unsuccessful payment, with buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Static payment success page confirming order placement, with links to continue shopping or return to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that fetches a single product by ID, displays its image and info, and supports add-to-cart and buy-now (Razorpay) actions with quantity selection.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop listing page that fetches all products and provides search, category, and status filters to display a filtered grid of ProductCard components.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility module exporting two helpers: formatINR for formatting numbers as Indian Rupee currency strings, and formatDate for converting nanosecond bigint timestamps to locale date strings.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Defines a static array of sample ProductInput objects (Ubtan, Neem, Sandalwood, etc.) used to seed the backend with demo product data including prices, images, specs, and statuses.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with an Ayurvedic brand color palette, custom fonts, botanical box shadows, admin-specific color tokens, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file recording existing and planned features for an Ayurvedic website, currently focused on a floating WhatsApp customer support button with theming, animations, and backend-driven configuration.
